factcheck.claim: Fathom Free includes unlimited recordings and transcriptions; Premium is $16/seat/mo annual ($20 monthly); Team is $15/seat/mo annual with HIPAA BAA; Business is $25/seat/mo annual; Enterprise is $35/seat/mo annual.

Otter Basic is free with 300 min/mo and 30 min per meeting; Pro is $16.99/seat/mo ($8.33 annual); Business is $30/seat/mo ($19.99 annual) with 4-hour meeting cap; Enterprise is custom with HIPAA add-on.

Fireflies Free includes 800 min storage and ~20 one-time AI credits (not monthly); Pro is $10/seat/mo annual ($18 monthly); Business is $19/seat/mo annual ($29 monthly); Enterprise is $39/seat/mo annual.

Granola Basic is free with 30-day meeting history; Business is $14/seat/mo (no annual discount); Enterprise is $35/seat/mo with HIPAA and SSO. Granola does not save audio/video, only AI-processed notes.

tl;dv Free includes unlimited recordings but only 10 AI summaries per month; Pro is $18/seat/mo annual ($29 monthly); Business is $29/seat/mo annual ($39 monthly). Hosted in Germany for EU GDPR scope.
Microsoft 365 Copilot is a $30/user/month add-on to Microsoft 365; runs as a Teams-native recap sidebar, not a visible bot; not a standalone product.

Across the 6-pick set, Fathom is the only tool where HIPAA ships on the team tier ($15/seat/mo annual). Otter, Fireflies, Granola, and tl;dv all gate HIPAA behind Enterprise (Otter custom add-on, Fireflies $39/seat/mo annual, Granola $35/seat/mo, tl;dv custom).

Bot-free honorable mentions in 2026: Jamie (EU-hosted, privacy-first UX), Krisp (noise-cancellation-plus-notes), Laxis (agent-driven CRM-template summaries for sales teams). All three are repeatedly named in 2026 reviews but each wins only an ultra-niche slice compared to the top-6 shortlist.
